desc:

**Position Type:** Consulting / Advisory (Short-Term / Hourly)
**Experience Required:** Strictly 15+ Years in ERP Implementation & Business Process Mapping

## Executive Summary

We are engineering **Bomax**, a revolutionary, multi-tenant Base SaaS ERP designed to handle intense data volumes with "Tally-like" ultra-high speeds. Our development team is ready to build, but before a single line of code is written, we need a veteran **ERP Functional Consultant & Subject Matter Expert** to validate and design our business logic, database structure, and operational workflows.

This is **not** a coding role. We need an architect who has spent over 15 years implementing heavy-duty ERPs (like SAP, MS Dynamics, or Odoo). You will map out the exact standard industry practices and database relationships we need to build a single core engine that simultaneously powers the **Heavy Machinery** industry and the **Dry Cleaning/Laundry** industry.

* **Single User / Single Store:** A standalone owner-operator.

title: NVIDIA AI Control PCBA Design
desc:
I need a lead-level hardware systems engineer who is comfortable building around NVIDIA AI modules and can take my concept all the way from schematic to assembled boards. The core task is to design, fabricate, and bring-up custom PCBAs that drive a control system while cleanly interfacing with three sensor classes—temperature sensors, motion detectors, and cameras.

Form factor, power budget, and component selection all matter in this build; I already have target size dimensions, allowable power envelope, and a shortlist of preferred parts that we will refine together. Once we lock the architecture you will prepare the complete design package, handle a short prototype run, and validate the hardware with the sensors hooked up.

Deliverables
• Schematics and PCB layout files
• Manufacturing outputs (Gerber, drill, pick-and-place, tested BOM)
• Assembled and first-article-tested boards
• Sensor integration report confirming stable operation with temperature, motion, and camera inputs
• Clear build notes and a brief hand-off document so my internal team can start firmware development immediately

Acceptance is based on the prototype boards powering up cleanly, meeting the agreed mechanical envelope, staying within the specified power draw, and correctly driving all three sensor types without signal integrity issues.

If you live and breathe NVIDIA-centric hardware design and have shipped control-oriented boards before, I’m ready to get started.

title: ISO 9001 SOPs & Documentation
desc:
I’m rebuilding our entire quality-management toolkit so it lines up perfectly with ISO 9001:2015. What I need is a full set of Standard Operating Procedures that nail every detail—clear process parameters, explicit role assignments, and step-by-step non-conformance workflows—while staying highly readable for operators and bullet-proof for auditors.

The scope extends beyond the written SOPs. I also require controlled documents that feed directly into each procedure, specifically:

• Audit-ready data logging sheets  
• Precise equipment calibration forms  
• Practical daily checksheets  

On top of that, I want cohesive QA/QC support materials, including JSA templates, a CAPA log, and site-inspection certificates, so the system feels seamless from factory floor to management review.

Deliverables  
1. ISO 9001-compliant SOP template and a complete suite of drafted procedures for all operational processes.  
2. Controlled-document pack: data logging sheet, calibration form, daily checksheet—each with document control codes and revision tracking.  
3. QA/QC templates: JSA, CAPA log, and site-inspection certificate.  
4. A document-control matrix mapping every file to the relevant ISO 9001:2015 clauses.

Acceptance criteria  
• Files supplied in editable Word or Excel formats.  
• Version-control footer on every page.  
• Content passes an internal desk audit for clause compliance and traceability.

title: AI-Powered Construction App Development
desc:
I’m ready to turn a concept for an AI-driven construction app into a working product and need a developer who can own the build from architecture to store release. The vision is an application that understands day-to-day site queries, learns from project data and offers smart, context-aware suggestions that make life easier for contractors and project managers.  

You’ll advise on the best way to combine mobile development with machine-learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch or a suitable cloud service, then implement, train and integrate the models directly into a clean, intuitive interface. I’m open to your preferred tech stack as long as the final result is maintainable and well-documented.

Deliverables
• Production-ready mobile app (cross-platform or native) compiled and installable  
• Trained AI models fully integrated and tested on real-world construction scenarios  
• Source code, build scripts and setup documentation  
• Lightweight admin panel for basic analytics and model fine-tuning  

Acceptance criteria: the app must answer sample construction queries with actionable recommendations in under two seconds, run without crashes on recent Android and iOS devices, and pass a simple code review for readability and organisation. If this sounds like a challenge you’d enjoy, let’s discuss timelines and milestones.

title: System Issue Troubleshooting Service
desc:
My environment is suffering from recurring problems that interrupt normal work—everything from unexpected errors to outright crashes and slowdowns. I need a seasoned troubleshooter to diagnose the root cause, implement a reliable fix, and verify stability afterward.

You will start by gathering information from system logs, crash dumps, configuration files, and any real-time monitoring data I can provide or you can set up. Once you narrow down the culprit, please document the steps taken to reproduce the fault, outline the corrective action, and apply the solution remotely (or supply clear instructions I can follow). A short post-repair report confirming that the issue no longer appears under typical workload conditions will complete the job.

Success for me is simple: the system runs smoothly for a full workday with no error dialogs, freezes, or unexplained slow performance. If additional optimisations or preventative measures emerge during the investigation, feel free to recommend them so we can decide on next steps together.

title: monday.com PPM Solution Architect
desc:
Over the next two weeks I am rolling out an enterprise-wide Portfolio-Program-Project management (PPM) environment inside monday.com. The engagement is capped at 40 billable hours and a total spend of ₹20,000, split evenly across two weekly milestones.

Scope of work  
• Build interconnected Portfolio, Program and Project boards that flow seamlessly from strategic initiatives down to individual tasks.  
• Layer in Automations and custom Workflows to keep data moving without manual hand-offs.  
• Expose key Portfolio metrics—resource allocation, performance indicators, task health—through live Dashboards at portfolio, program, project and task level.  
• Leverage make.com (Integromat) where native monday.com features fall short, packaging those scenarios as reusable apps.  
• Configure permissions, views and templates so the solution can be cloned across business units with minimal rework.

Acceptance criteria  
1. A working monday.com workspace containing Portfolio, Program and Project boards linked through mirrored columns and connected dashboards.  
2. Automated notifications, status roll-ups and resource calculations proven with test data.  
3. At least three make.com scenarios published as apps and documented.  
4. Comprehensive hand-over guide (Markdown or PDF) so internal admins can maintain and extend the setup.

I will grant full access to a sandbox account on day one and will be available for quick feedback loops throughout the sprint.

title: Set Up My Mango Orchard -- 2
desc:
I own about six-to-seven bighas of agricultural land just outside Sambhar in Rajasthan and I’m ready to convert it into a thriving mango orchard. What I need now is the right professional team to make it happen from day one.

Here’s the scope as I see it today:

• Variety guidance: I’d like your advice on which mango cultivars perform best in the Sambhar climate and soil profile so we maximise yield and market value.  
• Planting & spacing: Once the varieties are finalised, you will mark the grid, dig pits, supply or source healthy grafted saplings and plant them at the recommended spacing.  
• Irrigation setup: I want an efficient, low-wastage system installed at the same time—open to your suggestions on drip, sprinklers or any hybrid solution that suits local water availability and quality. Please include pump capacity, main and lateral line specs and a simple automation option in your plan.  
• Initial nutrition & pest protection: First-year fertigation or basal manuring plus a basic preventive spray schedule so the saplings establish well.  

Deliverables I expect:
1. A brief written plan covering chosen varieties, layout diagram and irrigation design.  
2. All materials and labour for the actual planting and system installation.  
3. A post-planting hand-over note with maintenance advice for the first three months.

title: ISO 9001 Quality Management System
desc:
We are looking for an experienced freelancer with expertise in ISO 9001:2015, Quality Management Systems (QMS), and Process Mapping to develop a complete set of Process Flow Diagrams for the Quality Control (QC) and Production Departments of a concrete products factory.
The project includes:
End-to-end QC and Production process flow diagrams.
Inspection and testing workflow.
Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs).
Required forms, checklists, and reports.
Roles and responsibilities (RACI).
Applicable ISO 9001:2015 requirements and relevant industry standards.
Requirements:
Proven experience in implementing ISO 9001:2015 in manufacturing.
Experience with concrete products factories is highly preferred.
Ability to deliver editable files (Visio/Lucidchart/Draw.io, Word, and Excel).
Please share your relevant experience and examples of similar projects with your proposal.
